assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one temporary client logo for the footer of a high-end film and photography agency. Primary request: create a sophisticated, distinctive symbol-only identity mark worthy of a carefully art-directed independent design studio. Flat black ink only, crisp vector-like geometry, intentional negative space, confident optical balance, unmistakably professional. No text, letters, numbers, labels, mockup, shading, gradients, shadows, frame, texture, or other logos. Genuinely transparent background. One centered standalone mark, with modest consistent clear space. Designed to stay recognizable and beautiful at 45 pixels high. Design direction: an intricate but simple interlocking folded ribbon emblem, three broad rounded bands weaving into a compact open hexagonal knot. Bold closed silhouette balanced by generous negative space; polished mid-century corporate identity craftsmanship. A compact near-square mark.
